exports.cells: one row per cell and path: the three arms and the decomposition
exports.decisions: acquisition decisions and what they cost, per arm
exports.availability: what was observable: sales, stockouts, recorded unmet demand, signals received
exports.truth: researcher-only ground truth, kept in its own file so it cannot be mistaken for agent information

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.note: Cheap, immediate, imprecise: a noisy reading of the current mean demand, in time to order on.

audit.name: Audit
audit.note: Expensive, immediate, precise: what a careful count of current conditions would show.

pilot.name: Pilot experiment
pilot.note: Precise but late: an almost exact reading of demand that arrives three periods after the decision it was bought for, so it informs the next decisions and not this one.

censored.name: Censored observer
censored.note: Sees its own sales, whether it stocked out, and unmet demand only where the environment records it.

censored_buyer.name: Censored observer that may buy information
censored_buyer.note: As the censored observer, and may buy an instrument before ordering.

free_info.name: Censored observer given an instrument free
free_info.note: As the censored observer, given the same instrument at the same rate with no choice and no charge.
